reply_text:
The 30 September digest says Mateo submitted ticket #8841. It describes drivers at the Newark facility being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk, and says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

I'd check that number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July you posted in #strategic-pod that you'd closed out "ticket #8841" with support. That one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and a kiosk browser-cache problem. So the digest may have reused an old number by mistake. I can't see the ticketing system, so I can't confirm which is right.

The only other ticket number I can see for Mateo is INC-4821, from the 3 August Hartford kiosk incident. It was about status-page access and doesn't mention Door 14 or Newark.

Look up Door 14 in the support queue directly, or ask Moss where the digest got #8841.
